raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE
Senior SRE / DevOps Engineer with 7+ years leading production reliability and cloud platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Expert in Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, and large-scale observability systems. Proven record reducing MTTR, rollout risk, and cloud spend through automation, progressive delivery, and AIOps. Driving platform maturity through SLOS, release governance, and predictive capacity planning.
